title: 4 SPEED TRANSMISSION-CONTENTS
summary: Contents of the M20 option section (4-speed manual transmission, also covering M21 close-ratio and M22 heavy-duty): transmission control rods (A2), shift rod adjustment (A3), interlock linkage and V.I.N. (vehicle identification number) stamping location (A4), and speedometer cable and back-up lamp switch (A5). A transmission drawing shows where each sheet applies.
notes_internal: Index page: no parts. UPC box prints 'M20' with 'M21-M22' beneath; group M20, options M20/M21/M22.

Drawing callouts: A5 at the speedometer cable and at the back-up lamp switch wiring on the case; A4 at the interlock linkage running forward (LH side); A2 at the shift rods; A3 at the rod/lever area near the shifter.
Torque legend triangles blank; no revisions. Page stamped K376; C/O A1, PREL 4-28-69.
